title: Felt Bicycles Recalls Cruiser Bicycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The bicycle's brakes can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 200.

title: IKEA Expands Recall of Crib Mattresses Due to Risk of Entrapment
summary: The crib mattresses could create a gap between the mattress and crib ends larger than allowed by federal regulations, posing an entrapment hazard to infants. Units: About 300,000 in the United States and about 44,000 in Canada (About 169,000 VYSSA crib mattresses were recalled in the U.S. in January

title: Avalanche Rescue Snow Shovels Recalled by Mountain Safety Research Due to Risk of Failure During Emergency Rescues (Recall Alert)
summary: The lower lock button on the avalanche snow shovel's shaft can fail to secure the blade, causing the shovel's shaft and blade to come apart and render the shovel unable to be used as intended to rescue avalanche victims. Units: About 4,300 in the United States and 340 in Canada.

title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Twist Swivel Stools Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The weld joint attaching the stool seat to the center post can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 125,000.

title: IKEA Recalls Pressure-Mounted Safety Gates Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The friction between the wall and the pressure-mounted safety gate is insufficient to hold the gate in its intended position, posing a fall hazard. In addition, the lower metal bar can be a tripping hazard. Units: About 58,000 in U.S. and 17,000 in Canada.

title: La-Z-Boy Recalls Wall Saver Power Reclining Furniture Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: When reclined, the furniture can tip forward if the consumer exits without bringing the chair to an upright position, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 2,600.

title: Schylling Recalls Police Press and Go Toy Vehicles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The hat can detach from the policeman's head and pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 13,200 in the U.S. and 2,100 in Canada.

title: Baby's Dream Recalls Cribs and Furniture Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The vintage gray paint on the cribs, furniture, and accessories exceeds federal lead limits. If ingested, lead can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 4,600 cribs and furniture pieces.

title: Power Reclining Furniture Recalled by Franklin Due to Fire Hazard; Power Switch Can Fail
summary: The switch used to operate the reclining function can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 81,000 in the U.S..

title: Snow Peak Recalls Japanese Axe Due to Laceration and Impact Hazards
summary: The handle of the axe can crack, allowing the axe head to come loose, posing a laceration or impact hazard to the user or bystanders. Units: About 220.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls GT Fury Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
summary: The front wheel hub can break and cause the disc brake system to fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the consumer. Units: About 160.

title: Great States Recalls Earthwise Cordless Electric Lawn Mowers Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The mower can start when the key is not in the starting position, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 1,200.

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Mason Jar Night Light Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The plastic around the base of the light bulb can melt, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 12,000.

title: BRP Recalls Youth Model Can-Am All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Violation of the Federal ATV Standard
summary: The youth ATVs fail to meet performance requirements of the federal ATV standard for maximum unrestricted speed and parking brakes, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 12,500.

title: Gerber Recalls Cohort Knives Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The locking mechanism can fail to hold the blade, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 150,000 in the United States and 11,000 in Canada.

title: OXO Recalls Nest Booster Seats Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The stitching on the restraint straps can loosen which allows the straps to separate from the seat, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 25,000 in the U.S. and 130 in Canada.

title: Viking Range Recalls Gas Ranges Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The ranges' ovens can turn on by themselves, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 52,000 in the U.S. and about 8,300 in Canada.

title: Vivint Recalls Remotec Dimming Switch Modules Due to Shock Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The module wiring is incorrectly installed, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 213,000.

title: Electrolux Recalls Kenmore Elite Ranges Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Sears
summary: The burner flame can go out while the gas is turned on. This can allow gas to escape and poses fire and burn hazards. Units: About 250.

title: Hewitt Recalls Marine Winches Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The top and bottom roller chains in the winch can break, causing the winch and marine lift to fail. This can pose an injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 1,700.

title: Kenmore Elite Ranges Recalled by Electrolux Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Sears
summary: The stainless steel trim below the range control panel can have a sharp edge, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,300.

title: Valor Athletics Recalls Olympic Weight Bench due to Injury Hazard
summary: The weld joining the front leg to the main frame can break, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: 100.

title: Kaldi's Coffee Roasting Recalls Cup Sleeves Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The cup sleeve can ignite if used in a microwave, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 700,000.

title: Precision Trading Recalls Espresso Makers Due to Risk of Burns
summary: The filler cap at the top of the unit can crack and allow steam to escape, posing a risk of burns to the user. In addition, the cap can pop off unexpectedly as a result of pressure buildup, posing a risk of injury to a bystander. Units: About 4,700.

title: Rocky Brands Recalls Rocky Rubber Snake Boots Due to Failure of Snake Guard
summary: The boots' snake guard can fail to protect the wearer's feet from a snake bite. Units: About 1,800.

title: TenPoint Crossbow Technologies Recalls to Repair Crossbows Due to Injury Hazard
summary: After the safety has been re-engaged, the crossbows can fire under certain circumstances if a consumer pulls the trigger, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 127,000.
